home.why1Text: Every trip is designed around moments, sunrise summits, bonfire stories, hidden waterfalls, not checkboxes on a schedule.
home.why2Text: Offbeat trails, quiet stays and smart timing that dodges the tourist rush. No queues, no chaos, just you and the moment.
home.why3Text: Stay, food, travel, permits, everything handled end to end. Your only job is to show up and be happy.
home.why4Text: Transparent prices, expert captains and 4.9★ rated memories. We measure our success in smiles.
home.ctaText: Hundreds of travellers found their escape with us. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll match you with an experience you'll never forget.

about.title: About Within Miles
about.subtitle: Born from a love for the road
about.story1: withinmiles.in began with one simple belief: happiness is never far away, it is just within miles. Our founder has travelled across 14 countries and led more than 300 trips, and what started as weekend treks with friends has grown into a family of hundreds of travellers exploring India's mountains, forts, beaches and beyond.
about.story2: Our team is a mix of certified trek leaders, technical adventure experts and passionate volunteers. We believe in mindful travel: small crowd-free batches, a strict no-littering trail policy, and deep respect for the local communities and mountains that host us. You bring the enthusiasm; we handle everything else.
about.mission1Text: Trained leaders, verified stays, first-aid readiness and well-planned routes on every single trip.
about.mission2Text: Solo traveller? You won't be alone for long. Our trips are where friendships begin.
about.mission3Text: We work with local hosts, guides and homestays, your travel supports real communities.

bot.greeting1: Arre hi! I'm Bunny 🎒, your travel buddy at withinmiles.in.
bot.greeting2: Mountains are calling, beaches are waiting... bas bag pack karna baaki hai! What are you in the mood for?
bot.pickRegion: Pick a place, I know all the good spots! 🏔️
bot.pickTrip: Here's what I've got, tap one and let's plan it! 👇
bot.noTrips: Hmm, nothing there right now, but new trips drop all the time! Try another place? 🧭
bot.vibeQ: Okay okay, tell me the vibe, what does your heart say? ❤️
bot.askBudget: Nice choice! What's your budget per person? 💰
bot.askDays: And how many days do you have? 📅
bot.noMatch: Honest answer: we don't have that kind of trip just yet, but new ones launch every month! 🔔
bot.recoIntro: Meanwhile, here's where I'd personally point you for that vibe:
bot.reco_mountains:
• Kedarkantha (Uttarakhand), classic winter summit
• Hampta Pass (Himachal), green-to-barren crossover
• Sandakphu (West Bengal), views of 4 of the world's 5 highest peaks
bot.reco_beach:
• Gokarna (Karnataka), quiet beach-hopping trails
• Tarkarli (Konkan), scuba and white sands
• Varkala (Kerala), cliffside sunsets
bot.reco_spiritual:
• Kashi and Ayodhya (UP), the grand Ganga Aarti
• Bhimashankar (Maharashtra), jyotirlinga + forest trek
• Rishikesh (Uttarakhand), yoga by the Ganges
bot.reco_roadtrip:
• Spiti Valley (Himachal), the cold desert circuit
• Konkan coastal road (Maharashtra), beaches and forts
• Ladakh, the ultimate high-altitude drive
